title: Clarify Expense Agent Entra app permission checks
summary: Permission checks for the Expense Agent Entra app have been reordered to match the setup flow and documented to clarify why non-SUPER users need additional permissions beyond Expense Mgmt. Admin.
key_points: Reordered authorization checks to follow the setup flow sequence
Added documentation explaining why non-SUPER users require SECURITY, Expense Agent, and Agent - Admin permissions
Preserved existing SUPER user bypass behavior
Authorization rule remains: SUPER or (Expense Mgmt. Admin and SECURITY and Expense Agent and Agent - Admin and Configure All Agents)
No changes to actual permission model or runtime behavior
quote: Reorder the Expense Agent Entra application authorization checks to follow the setup flow.
